name: Nephrotic Syndrome-Epidermolysis Bullosa-Sensorineural Deafness Syndrome
aliases: Nephrotic Syndrome with Epidermolysis Bullosa and Sensorineural Deafness

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Triad Diagnostic Criteria for NSEBSD Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of nephrotic syndrome characterized by proteinuria, hypoalbuminemia, and edema
Congenital or early-onset epidermolysis bullosa with skin fragility and blistering
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss confirmed by audiometry
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes associated with the syndrome (e.g., CD151 gene)
Renal biopsy showing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis or mesangial sclerosis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (nephrotic syndrome, epidermolysis bullosa, and sensorineural deafness) must be present for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing and renal biopsy findings support diagnosis but are not mandatory.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Congenital epidermolysis bullosa with skin blistering
pathognomonic.notes: Skin fragility leading to blister formation after minor trauma
searchTerms: fragile skin with blisters at birth

pathognomonic.notes: Marked protein loss in urine causing hypoalbuminemia and edema
searchTerms: kidney disease causing swelling and proteinuria
hearing loss from nerve damage both ears

common.notes: Swelling commonly affecting lower limbs and face
Persistent skin lesions prone to infection

common.symptomName: Hypoalbuminemia confirmed by serum protein electrophoresis
common.notes: Low serum albumin levels due to renal loss

common.symptomName: Delayed speech development secondary to hearing loss
common.notes: Speech delay related to auditory impairment
searchTerms: speech delay due to hearing loss
speech problems caused by hearing issues

occasional.notes: Elevated blood pressure in some patients
searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney disease
renal involvement leading to high blood pressure

occasional.notes: Secondary bacterial infections of skin lesions
Poor growth due to chronic illness
Foamy appearance of urine due to protein content

rare.notes: Occasional eye surface damage related to epithelial fragility
Mild anemia due to chronic inflammation or renal loss
searchTerms: low red blood cells due to long-term disease

rare.notes: Limited joint mobility due to skin scarring
Rare involvement causing additional protein loss

laboratory: Elevated serum creatinine in advanced renal disease
imaging: Renal ultrasound showing normal or increased echogenicity
Audiometry confirming bilateral sensorineural hearing loss
other: Skin biopsy showing epidermolysis bullosa with cleavage within the basement membrane zone
Renal biopsy demonstrating focal segmental glomerulosclerosis or mesangial sclerosis

distinguishingFeatures: Variable renal involvement without nephrotic syndrome
Progressive nephritis with hematuria rather than nephrotic syndrome
Characteristic basement membrane changes on renal biopsy

redFlags: Rapidly progressive nephrotic syndrome with renal failure
Severe skin blistering leading to secondary infection
Early-onset bilateral sensorineural deafness impairing development
